name: MediaBookmark
description: Contains properties and methods that specify information about the bookmark of the media.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns the index position of the bookmark. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the name of the bookmark. Read-only.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns the time that is associated with the bookmark. Read-only.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the bookmark from the collection.
